parsed_json.up: Select distinct molecule ChEMBL ID, preferred name as molecule_name, maximum clinical phase, molecule type, and canonical SMILES for compounds reported in the specified document. Join docs to compound_records on doc_id, then to molecule_dictionary on molregno, and inner join compound_structures on molregno to require structures. Filter by document ChEMBL ID CHEMBL5260813. Sort by molecule ChEMBL ID ascending.
